findings.issue: The Source Files row for frontier-admit.cjs reads as a full list of what the script does: 'Seeds, admits and closes frontier nodes. Its `graph` command builds the frontier graph events through `buildFrontierGraphEvents`.' The script now accepts six commands: seed, admit, close, graph, block and budget (frontier-admit.cjs:1111-1112). The row leaves out the new `budget` command, which step_frontier_budget runs (deep-research.yaml:788) to write the budget derived from the seed into deep-research-config.json (frontier-admit.cjs:435-450, 1118). It also leaves out the `block` command, which renders the leaf FRONTIER block from --focus-file (frontier-admit.cjs:1127-1134; deep-research.yaml:1639).

evidence.cmd: rg -n "expected seed, admit, close, graph, block or budget|command === 'budget'" .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/frontier-admit.cjs
